cases.oracle: Original sudoedit obligations, independently encoded x86-64 UAPI and SHA-256 request digest, observable private guest files, controlled same-uid editor, exact raw request/reply and fd-vector traces. Synthetic OPEN/COPYBACK perform only uid-2000 scratch operations; real kernel safe-open is unproved.
cases.comparison: Setup independently constructs authorization requests, proves corrupted digest rejection and rejects a wrong temp descriptor, then exercises a valid synthetic two-handle OPEN/edit/COPYBACK. The peer accepts only private scratch targets, records exact bytes and transitions, uses separately minted handles, matches request digest/argv, and never changes credentials. Success invokes an owned guarded editor and checks actual private bytes; rejection checks no private target changed and every returned temp was unlinked. Sixteen targets and count/path rejection are bounded. PR_SET_DUMPABLE is acknowledged without application if requested. Listener bootstrap is precompiled and sends its listener before supervised operations; diagnostic stage files record the handoff. The source-review ownership and embedded-payload guard repairs are included.
cases.purpose: Reach actual guarded editor and observe one, two and sixteen target requests and synthetic private copyback.
